description: Prime Agent through Prime Intellect's curl installer, which writes ~/.local/bin/prime-agent and ~/.prime.
why: ~/.local/bin/prime-agent is the only witness, so removing it turns must_find red. ~/.prime is on disk and forbid_evidence holds it unclaimed, because Prime Intellect's separate `prime` CLI keeps its config there too. claude-code and codex-cli are forbidden because ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories are their routes too.
known_gaps: The installer refuses glibc below 2.35, so the scenario exits 3 on Rocky 9 and Amazon Linux 2023.
The Windows installer (install.ps1) is not exercised.
